# Documents of testdata/liquid (tools/mjml-reference/liquid.mjs) that safe-mjml renders
# differently from MJML 4.18 on purpose, checked by TestLiquidTemplates. Format: name: reason.
# Remove a line when the document matches MJML.

text-style-if--inline: a {% if %} block inside a style attribute that an inline mj-style rewrites: MJML's juice does not protect {% %}, reads the block as broken declarations and drops them with the rest of the attribute (color and margin are lost whatever the condition); safe-mjml keeps the block and the declarations (docs/differences-from-mjml.md, "Template tags are kept intact by inline mj-style")
social-element-href: an mj-social-element href that already points to the network (https://x.com/{{ social.x_handle }}) is kept as written, where MJML wraps it in the share URL (docs/differences-from-mjml.md, mj-social-href-on-network)
social-element-href--inline: same as social-element-href
